_schema: English mirror of kunden.json, keyed by customer id (not an array). Only text fields: name, typ, tells[], saetze{gruss[], kauf[], ablehnung[], reveal[]}. List lengths match the German ones so the cyclic line counter stays in sync. Missing ids or fields fall back to German. Tone: Lebowski / surfer, situational comedy.

stammkunde_1.name: The Walrus Guy
tells: sandals, worn flat
Hawaiian shirt with a stain
sunburn
has been standing in the same spot for hours
gold chain: pays the markup, mostly

gruss: Duuude.
You're still here. Me too.
Was just thinking about clouds.
kauf: You're a saint, man.
That holds the afternoon together.
I owe you. Like, even more.
ablehnung: Also fine. Everything's fine.
Then... I'll keep watching the sea.
No stress. I'm stress-free anyway.

surfer_1.name: Kai
tells: barefoot, wet footprints
tank top, board under the arm
can't run, doesn't want to

gruss: Bro. The wave was... yeah.
You know the trick where you just stay lying down?
Back in the water in a sec. Or later. Or whatever.
kauf: Bro. Bro. Bro.
Taking this out with me. Not into the water. But out.
Best wave of the day, and I'm standing on land.
ablehnung: All good, the sea's still there.
Tomorrow then. Or the day after. Time is water.
Chill. I chill.

backpacker_1.name: Jonas from Bielefeld
tells: trekking sandals, dusty
backpack bigger than him
festival wristband
too much man bun

gruss: Hi! I saved for 14 months to do exactly nothing here.
Got here yesterday and I've already, like, arrived.
Hey, do you know a good... place? For things?
kauf: This goes in the travel blog. Well, no. But inside.
My hostel bed has a name. Now it has a reason too.
You're the first person here who didn't ask me about the wifi.
ablehnung: Okay, no problem, I just wanted to talk anyway.
I get it. I probably still look too new.
Alright. Then I'll go... find myself somewhere.

rentner_1.name: Mr. Pfeiffer
tells: SOCKS in sandals (a clean polo is NOT an undercover sign here)
straw hat, camera
only has small change
is actually looking for the hotel

gruss: Young man, is this still the hotel?
My wife says I should do something crazy for once.
Excuse me, do you sell postcards too?
kauf: This happened in the sixties too.
Don't tell Hannelore.
I pay in coins, the wife has the paper money.
ablehnung: Alright, postcards then.
Fair enough, I've got the hotel.
Hannelore wouldn't have allowed it anyway.

oma_1.name: Grandma Lek
tells: flip-flops, smock, walker
always haggles
knows every cop by first name
best customer, pays the most
gold chain: pays any markup (her knees are worth it)

gruss: You look thin. Have you eaten?
For my knees, you understand.
Psst. Not so loud. I'm known around here.
kauf: My grandson says it's medicine. My grandson is a doctor. Well, almost.
Hand it over, and don't forget the change.
Pong never asks me. I changed his diapers.
ablehnung: Then I'll ask the bar.
Too pricey. Too little. Too young.
My husband was nicer. God rest him, the rascal.

erstkaeufer_1.name: Timo
tells: flip-flops (trips when running)
looks over his shoulder every 2 seconds
talks WAY too loud
phone in hand, flashlight on, in daylight
gold chain: pays any markup, out of nerves

gruss: HELLO. I AM TOTALLY NORMAL HERE.
Is this... so... do you... you know?
I've never done this. Like, THIS. This here. Buying.
kauf: THANKS. I mean, quiet thanks. THANKS.
Where do I put it now? In my hand? Is my hand okay?
I'll walk away normally now. Totally normal. Normal.
ablehnung: Okay. Okay. Okay. Just kidding anyway.
Fine, I didn't want anything either. Who are you?
I SAID NOTHING.

jogger_1.name: Sven, always running
tells: SNEAKERS, but: headband, pulse watch, jersey = athlete, not a cop
runs on the spot
happily pays, then tells the next cop about it (heat 1)

gruss: Quick break. Pulse. Hi.
Kilometer twelve. I'm rewarding myself.
I run past here every day, and every day I think: today.
kauf: Perfect for recovery.
That counts as electrolytes, right?
Thanks! I won't tell anyone. Except maybe my run club.
ablehnung: No biggie, I'll keep running.
I get it, you think I'm a cop. I'm just fit.
Tomorrow again, same time, same pace.

zivi_1.name: Inspector Polo
tells: sneakers, blinding white
polo with an ironed crease
earpiece
says 'totally normal' suspiciously often
gold chain, but: undercover pays any price, it is evidence (greed trap)

gruss: Hello! I'm a totally normal tourist.
Nice beach. For totally normal activities.
I'd like what everyone here has. The usual.
kauf: Interesting. Very interesting.
Thanks. This will be... noted. I mean: enjoyed.
Could you repeat that, a little louder?
ablehnung: Shame. For you.
I see. Same spot tomorrow, then?
No problem. I'm only here for fun anyway. On duty.
reveal: Control, target has taken the bait.
You have the right to remain silent. Please use it, I'm tired.

zivi_2.name: Shirt with a Price Tag
tells: SANDALS, still undercover: earpiece
brand-new Hawaiian shirt, price tag still on
socks in sandals (like a retiree, but 30 years too young)
secretly takes notes
gold chain, but: undercover pays any price, markup = more evidence

gruss: Yo, dude. Bro. Mate. Did I miss one?
I'm totally relaxed. Look, Hawaiian shirt.
So what does the... merchandise go for, brother?
kauf: Nice. Groovy. Further youth words.
May I quickly note... I mean, enjoy?
That's exactly the amount I needed. For the file. For me!
ablehnung: Uncool, man. Very unc... very unfortunate.
Then I'll ask elsewhere, relaxed. Relaxed.
No worries, digga. Did I use that right?
reveal: The shirt was uniform. So were the socks.
Control? Yeah, the price-tag trick worked. No, no idea why.
You're under arrest. And my shirt is now tax deductible.

zivi_3.name: The Guy with Rex
tells: BAREFOOT and tank top look harmless, but:
German shepherd with a blue bandana (beach dogs don't wear bandanas)
radio on the belt, disguised as a 'bottle opener'
the dog sniffs your bag
gold chain, but: Rex decides, not the price

gruss: Rex is just a normal beach dog.
Sit, Rex. No, not you. I meant the dog.
Nice day for... whatever you've got on you.
kauf: Rex, mark. I mean: Rex, sit.
Thanks. Rex has made up his mind anyway.
That smells... interesting. Says Rex.
ablehnung: Smart kid. Rex, we're leaving.
Rex is disappointed. Rex has a memory.
Okay. We're here again tomorrow. Rex and me. Coincidence.
reveal: Rex, attack. No, Rex. ATTACK. Rex!
Control, the dog found it. I just watched.
Rex is an officer. You're under arrest. Both of you.

fischer_1.name: Chai from the fish stand
tells: RUBBER BOOTS in the sun = fish stand, not monsoon
apron with scales
the cat follows him, not the police
you smell him before you see him

gruss: Up since four. What've you got?
The cat stole my fish. Hope it doesn't steal you.
Not so close. You smell like tourist.
kauf: For after the market. Or during.
Hand it over before Pong comes by. He always comes at eleven.
You get a fish with it. Take the fish. Please.
ablehnung: Fine. You don't want fish either, do you?
Tomorrow then. I'm always here. Always.
The cat has more business sense than you.

lauter_typ_1.name: Lars, Volume 11
tells: sandals, jersey, beer can: harmless
but: you can hear him across the whole market (heat 2 on sale)
fanny pack full of change
sunburn in the shape of a jersey
gold chain: pays the markup, LOUDLY

gruss: HEY! YOU GOT WEED?!
YOU! YEAH YOU! ARE YOU THE GUY?!
DUDE, I'VE HEARD ABOUT YOU! EVERYONE'S HEARD ABOUT YOU!
kauf: SWEET! GUYS, HE'S GOT IT! HE REALLY HAS!
THANKS, MAN! WHAT'S YOUR NAME? WHERE DO YOU LIVE?!
I WON'T TELL ANYONE! YOU HEAR? ANYONE!
ablehnung: OKAY! GOT IT! NO WEED FROM THIS GUY!
SHAME! I'LL ASK THAT ONE OVER THERE!
ALL GOOD! I'M QUIET! QUIET!

touristin_1.name: Mrs. Dr. Hat
tells: hat bigger than the market stall
cruise wristband: has to be back on the ship by five
pays little, but buys every day
photographs everything, including you (harmless, but embarrassing)

gruss: Yoo-hoo! Do you live here? You look so relaxed.
My husband's asleep on the ship. I'm having experiences.
May I take a photo? No? I'll take one anyway.
kauf: This goes in the travel diary. As 'spice'.
Delightful. Do you have postcards of it too?
I have to be on the ship by five. Will it last till then?
ablehnung: Oh, I see. Mangoes, then.
Pity, I would have loved to do something forbidden. Just once.
Fine. My husband says I overdo it anyway.

zivi_4.name: Backpacker with Questions
tells: looks like Jonas, BUT: sneakers instead of trekking sandals
backpack hangs flat: empty (no backpacker travels with an empty backpack)
ferry ticket from TODAY, stubble from yesterday
doesn't ask for the goods, asks WHERE they come from
outline of handcuffs in the pocket
gold chain, but: the markup goes in the file

gruss: Hey! Just got off the ferry. So where does one get... you know?
Cool market. Who supplies who around here, anyway?
I collect experiences. And names. I mean, experiences.
kauf: Great. And where exactly is this from? Just curious.
Thanks! Your supplier, is he this nice too?
Perfect, that's enough. I mean: that's enough for me today.
ablehnung: Shame. Do you know who else... never mind.
I see. Then I'll ask up on the hill. Someone lives there, right?
No problem. I'm here three more days. At least.
reveal: The ferry was official channels. Literally.
Control, target hinted at a supplier. Hill. I repeat: hill.
The backpack was empty because your bag goes in it now.

bauer_nok.name: Farmer Nok
tells: barefoot with mud up to the knees: stands in water all day, runs nowhere
conical hat, no shirt
pays in rice (same value, heavier to carry)
only talks in weather

gruss: Rain's coming. Not today. But it's coming.
You're the boy from the hill. Your mentor steals my water.
Don't come into the field. The herons don't like sandals.
kauf: I pay in rice. Rice is money you can eat.
For the evenings. The frogs are loud.
The buffalo sees nothing. The buffalo never sees anything.
ablehnung: Then not. The rice grows anyway.
Tomorrow. Or after the rain. Or never. All the same.
My father never bought either. He grew.

kletterer_1.name: Dao, way up there
tells: helmet with a dent: the coconut was faster
rope around the hips, calluses on the feet
doesn't run away, climbs away (patrol looks up, sees only palm tree)
throws coconuts when in danger, never hits

gruss: From up there you see everything. You too. Especially you.
Heads up! No, kidding. The nut's already down.
I was just twenty meters above Pong. He didn't notice.
kauf: For up there. It's quiet. And it sways.
I'll take this up the tree. Nobody looks there.
Can I pay in coconut? No? Okay, coins. Nut's on the house.
ablehnung: Then I'll climb sober. Also fine, fewer dents.
I'll ask again from up top. You won't hear me there.
No problem. The palm's waiting. It always waits.

zivi_5.name: Mrs. Whistle
tells: shoes and shirt are innocent: flip-flops, stained Hawaiian shirt (borrowed), sunburn
BUT: pale cap stripe on the forehead, sunburn only below it
whistle on a cord around the neck, disguised as jewelry
stands bolt upright, no slacker stands like that
can't run (flip-flops), whistles for backup instead
gold chain, but: the markup is worth the whistle

gruss: Good day! I mean: hey. Hey, dude.
Nice beach. I'm here privately. Very privately.
Do you have... do you maybe have something relaxing? For relaxing?
kauf: Thank you. This will be... enjoyed. Privately.
Very good. Very, very good. Please stay right there for a moment.
Perfect. Excuse me, I just need to... whistle.
ablehnung: I see. Then I'll keep strolling. On duty. Privately!
No problem. I'm here tomorrow too. From eight. Shift start. Beach start!
Pity. My boss... my husband would have been pleased.
reveal: The whistle isn't jewelry. The stripe isn't fashion.
Control, stroll complete, target is standing next to me. Yes, in flip-flops. Yes, me too.
I can't run. I don't have to. Pong's coming. Eventually.

paar_1.name: The Newlyweds
tells: identical Hawaiian shirts, identical 'JUST MARRIED' caps
sandals, harmless
BUT: they photograph everything and post it (heat 1: you're on the internet now)
talk at the same time, finish each other's sentences

gruss: Hi! We're— / —on our honeymoon! / Since yesterday! / Day before, honey.
We want something local! / Something real! / Is this real?
Our tour guide says there are— / —experiences here!
kauf: Selfie! / Smile! / You too! / Perfect!
This goes in the blog! / No, honey. / Just in the story!
Thanks, thanks! / We're Lisa and— / He's also Lisa. Long story.
ablehnung: Oh. / Okay. / Coconut then? / Coconut!
We get it. / Totally. / We're not like that either. / We are.
Pity. / Pity. / We photographed it anyway.
